reviewNotes: Emphasizes technical leadership, business-system integrations, AWS migration, asynchronous performance, and operational automation. The master does not establish the required three years of production AI/ML implementation, agent frameworks, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, ML frameworks, AI mentoring, or enterprise-scale architecture design. It also does not document Microsoft Graph API, Snowflake, infrastructure automation, or the preferred Azure and data-platform technologies. Listed AI tools do not establish production AI engineering experience.
